notes: Easy: reclaim the content of an unlinked-but-open file descriptor via /proc/<pid>/fd. The only subtlety is selecting the right descriptor: the keeper also holds decoy fds whose paths still exist, so the tool must match the '(deleted)' readlink suffix and skip unreadable/non-numeric entries. The verifier executes the deliverable tool against the live visible keeper and against freshly spawned hidden keepers with different payload bytes/sizes (1.5 KiB and 12 KiB), pidfile locations, and decoys, byte-comparing outputs; a wrong-fd read or a name-based (not fd-based) recovery fails. Rubric is small across the board, bucketing to easy.
